metas.name: Drink: A Look Inside the Glass
metas.description: An epic adventure into the stories of the world's most renowned alcohol producers. Each episode focuses on a single drink and its premier maker as they reveal the history, process, and craft that goes into every bottle.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something
metas.description: Follow true crime influencer Kara Chamberlain as she investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have stumped law enforcement and haunted internet sleuths for decades.

metas.name: Witness to Disaster
metas.description: Hard-hitting amateur, CCTV and news footage reveals how some of the world's biggest natural disasters took away people's lives, homes and hope in Witness Disaster.

metas.name: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
metas.description: O trágico atentado a um voo transatlântico sobre a Escócia, em 1988, junta a polícia local e o FBI numa caça aos autores do ataque.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: Nathan For You é uma série documental de comédia americana, em que o protagonista, Nathan Fieldier, usa a sua licenciatura em Gestão de Negócios para aconselhar pequenas empresas a ganharem lucro, muitas vezes através de meios excêntricos e pouco habituais. A personagem de Nathan é baseada na vida real do próprio Nathan Fielder e da sua luta interior contra a ansiedade social.

metas.name: Ice Cold Gold
metas.description: Follows a spirited team of miners who are among the first Americans to prospect for precious metals and gems in parts of Greenland where humans never have set foot before.

metas.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
metas.description: Após um acidente numa mina no norte do Chile, 33 mineiros ficaram presos nas profundezas do subsolo. À medida que as buscas por eles começam, os homens lutam pelas suas vidas em condições extremas.

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
metas.description: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

metas.name: Apocalypse: Hitler attaque à l'Ouest
metas.description: May 10th, 1940, Hitler takes on the West. Will he precipitate Europe into the Apocalypse?

metas.name: Clarkson's Farm
metas.description: Siga Jeremy enquanto faz a agricultura. O homem que afirma ser alérgico ao trabalho manual assume o trabalho mais manual intensivo de trabalho. O que poderia dar errado?
